canonical_statement: The study assessed real-world nirsevimab effectiveness against PCR-confirmed RSV lower respiratory tract disease and RSV-associated health care utilization at Kaiser Permanente Northern California during the 2023–2024 RSV season.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We assessed nirsevimab effectiveness against PCR-confirmed RSV LRTD and RSV-associated health care utilization...

canonical_statement: The investigators conducted a retrospective cohort study in Kaiser Permanente Northern California with follow-up from October 19, 2023 through April 30, 2024.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We conducted a retrospective cohort study... Follow-up began October 19, 2023 and continued through April 30, 2024.

canonical_statement: The analytic cohort contained 31,900 healthy term infants; 15,647 received nirsevimab and 16,253 did not receive nirsevimab during the study period.

population.label: Nirsevimab-eligible healthy term infants born April 2023 or later in Kaiser Permanente Northern California

canonical_statement: Eligible infants were born from April 1, 2023 through April 30, 2024, were born at Kaiser Permanente Northern California, and had maternal prenatal care within the system.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: healthy infants born April 1, 2023 through April 30, 2024... born at KPNC and whose mothers received prenatal care at KPNC

canonical_statement: Infants born before 37 weeks gestation or with prespecified high-risk conditions were excluded from the healthy-term cohort.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Healthy infants were defined as those born at ≥37 weeks gestational age without a high-risk condition...

canonical_statement: Infants whose mothers received maternal RSV vaccination during pregnancy were excluded.

canonical_statement: Infants with a positive RSV PCR test before October 19, 2023 were excluded from analysis.

canonical_statement: Routine nirsevimab administration at Kaiser Permanente Northern California began October 19, 2023, with eligible infants offered nirsevimab before discharge, in urgent care, or at outpatient well-child visits.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Routine nirsevimab administration at KPNC began October 19, 2023...

canonical_statement: The primary outcome was the first PCR-confirmed RSV infection associated with a lower respiratory tract disease diagnosis in any setting from 7 days before through 10 days after the positive RSV PCR test.

canonical_statement: A co-primary utilization outcome was the number of medical encounters during an RSV LRTD episode, with encounters categorized as outpatient, emergency department, inpatient, or ICU care.

canonical_statement: Effectiveness analyses used Cox regression on a calendar timeline, stratified by birth month and adjusted for sex and race and/or ethnicity; effectiveness was calculated as 100 × (1 − adjusted hazard ratio).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Cox regression on a calendar timeline adjusted for sex and race and/or ethnicity stratified by birth month. Estimated as 1 − HRAdj expressed as a percentage.

canonical_statement: The number of medical encounters was analyzed with linear regression, and post hoc hospitalization and emergency-department outcomes among RSV LRTD cases were analyzed with logistic regression, adjusted for birth month, sex, and race and/or ethnicity.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that nirsevimab was highly effective against RSV LRTD, hospitalized RSV LRTD, and milder PCR-confirmed RSV infection in healthy term infants during the 2023–2024 season.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: These findings suggest that nirsevimab was highly effective in protecting against RSV-associated lower respiratory tract disease as well as against milder RSV infection.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that routine nirsevimab use may reduce RSV-associated health care utilization in both inpatient and outpatient settings.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: These results suggest that routine use of nirsevimab may reduce the burden of RSV-associated utilization in both the inpatient and outpatient settings.
